# platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Admin — Service Accounts

> 9 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Admin under Service Accounts. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Service Accounts

- [Add Workspace To Service Account](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/service_accounts/workspaces/create.md): Tagged workspace ID to add the service account to.
- [Archive Service Account](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/service_accounts/archive.md): Archive a service account.
- [Create Service Account](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/service_accounts/create.md): Slug identifier (lowercase, digits, hyphens). Unique within the organization; a duplicate name returns 409.
- [Get Service Account](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/service_accounts/retrieve.md): Retrieve a service account by its ID (`svac_...`).
- [List Service Accounts](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/service_accounts/list.md): Include archived resources. Defaults to false.
- [List Workspaces For Service Account](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/service_accounts/workspaces/list.md): Tagged ID (`user_...`/`svac_...`) of the actor who created this membership.
- [Remove Workspace From Service Account](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/service_accounts/workspaces/delete.md): Tagged service account ID (`svac_...`) named in the delete request. Removal is idempotent; see the endpoint description for the implicit-membership no-op.
- [Update Service Account](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/service_accounts/update.md): Update a service account.
- [Workspaces](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/service_accounts/workspaces.md): Tagged workspace ID to add the service account to.
